title: fix(payments): receive package bank authentication returns [T4]
body:
## HUNT-04-124 (agent 124) — client pays on day 1

**Tier: T4. Grade: B 1 / U 0 / C 0 in this change.**

Current head: `c1dfc699ce1a12d616fb5b99371bf89ce819221e`. 255 changed lines / 3 files. Required checks green; READY FOR AUDIT, not a merge approval.

### B-H04-1 — package purchases never receive the bank authentication return

An ordinary client buys a coaching plan, authenticates in the bank's app or browser, and returns to TGP, but the package PaymentSheet never receives that return URL to complete the purchase.

`usePackagePurchase.runSheet()` supplies `tgp://stripe-redirect` to Stripe but had no URL listener. The only `handleURLCallback` listener in the app was inside the separately mounted UpdateCardScreen. All three package selling surfaces use this hook.

### Small fix

- Install a return-URL listener immediately before PaymentSheet presentation.
- Forward only the exact Stripe return route (including its query/fragment), only while the current account/screen owns the sheet.
- Remove the listener when the sheet finishes, cancels, fails, or throws.
- Do not log URLs, retain secrets, grant access, or create any extra payment.
- Callback failures keep the existing uncertain-result and Check again recovery.
- No backend, general linking, environment, workflow, lockfile, or MONEY-* owned files changed.

### Failing-first evidence

- First commit adds real-hook tests without the implementation.
- Red lane: https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37522229936 — all 4 original tests failed for the intended missing callback/cleanup.
- Fix adds the scoped listener plus 5 real-hook tests: bank return success; unrelated links/cancel; decline; callback failure/uncertain result; late webhook/Check again without a second POST.
- Local targeted fallback was attempted through heavy.sh but shared dependencies have no jest-expo preset; no local test result is claimed.
- Green normal CI: https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37523670958 — typecheck/lint pass, 597 suites / 8,265 tests / 5 snapshots pass, including the new day1Return spec.
- Green CodeQL: https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37523670871 — both language analyses pass.
- Two test-fixture corrections followed the initial code push: preserve EmitterSubscription's declared type; capture the RN preset's mock implementation rather than its mutable jest.fn. No implementation change after the opening head.
- No extra lane beyond the single red lane, no CI canceled, no paid actions.

### Ownership / decisions

HUNT-01 notified; no RootNavigator/App/app.json edits. MONEY-* claims remain untouched.

Recommended default: land after both T4 lenses approve the exact head and required checks are green, before the next mobile build. No dashboard switch is needed for this code fix.
